final_message: I wrote the 13 matching functions to [answer.json](/tmp/bsvc-l2e7o5mf/billing-service/answer.json) and verified that it is valid JSON.

steps.command: /bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,190p' billing/api.py; sed -n '1,180p' billing/engine.py; sed -n '1,180p' billing/payments.py; sed -n '1,130p' billing/catalog.py; sed -n '1,125p' billing/pricing.py; sed -n '1,100p' billing/store.py"

/bin/zsh -lc ".venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import ast, pathlib
for path in sorted(pathlib.Path('billing').glob('*.py')):
    tree=ast.parse(path.read_text())
    for node in tree.body:
        funcs=[(node,None)] if isinstance(node,(ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) else [(n,node.name) for n in node.body if isinstance(n,(ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef))] if isinstance(node,ast.ClassDef) else []
        for fn,cls in funcs:
            returns=[n for n in ast.walk(fn) if isinstance(n,ast.Return)]
            if not returns: continue
            explicit=any(n.value is not None for n in returns)
            if not explicit: continue
            annotation=ast.unparse(fn.returns) if fn.returns else ''
            direct_none=any(isinstance(n.value,ast.Constant) and n.value.value is None for n in returns)
            if 'None' in annotation or direct_none:
                print(f'{path.stem}.{cls+\".\" if cls else \"\"}{fn.name} -> {annotation}; direct_none={direct_none}')
PY"
/bin/zsh -lc 'ls -l answer.json; git ls-files answer.json; git check-ignore -v answer.json'
